how: Stand and without trying to change anything feel the soles of your feet. Where is your weight: balls, toes, heels?  Is it even is it uneven.  Imagine you are just bringing little cameras to the bottom of your feet.   Notice what happens.  Start with one foot, then another, then you can move up to ankles, knees, hips etc.
name: Soles Support (Feet)
notes: Test with shoes on before using with groups.
